description: AgentProvenance v0.9.0 run in the setting it targets: each execution in its own process tree and cgroup (N0), against a shared cgroup (N1) and a shared worker (N3). Synthetic E1 workload with correct labels; one ToolCallScope binding per operation, registered with the process tree and cgroup that served it and the exact operation window. FACT runs on the same rounds. Same reference (destination port -> execution).
